question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as DORMANT.
explanation: Dormant = Dormant = निष्क्रिय, सुप्त (Inert = Inert = निश्चल, जड़)। Example: The volcano has been dormant for centuries.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as EXQUISITE.
explanation: Exquisite = Exquisite = उत्कृष्ट, बारीक और सुंदर (Refined = Refined = परिष्कृत)। Example: She wore an exquisite silk saree.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as IMPEDIMENT.
explanation: Impediment = Impediment = बाधा, (बोलने की) रुकावट (Defect = Defect = दोष)। Example: A speech impediment never stopped him from singing.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as INGENUITY.
explanation: Ingenuity = Ingenuity = आविष्कारशीलता, चतुराई (Creativity = Creativity = सृजनशीलता)। Example: The engineer solved the problem with great ingenuity.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as INTRIGUED.
explanation: Intrigued = Intrigued = उत्सुक, आकर्षित (Fascinated = Fascinated = मंत्रमुग्ध)। Example: The children were intrigued by the magic trick.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as JEOPARDIZED.
explanation: Jeopardized = Jeopardized = ख़तरे में डाला (Endangered = Endangered = संकट में पड़ा)। Example: Careless driving jeopardized many lives.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as MALFEASANCE.
explanation: Malfeasance = Malfeasance = पद का दुरुपयोग, अनुचित आचरण (Misconduct = Misconduct = दुराचरण)। Example: The officer was suspended for malfeasance.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as MOORED.
explanation: Moored = Moored = (नाव) बाँधी/लंगर डाली हुई (Anchored = Anchored = लंगर से बँधी)। Example: The boat was moored at the jetty.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as OUTLANDISH.
explanation: Outlandish = Outlandish = अजीबोग़रीब (Bizarre = Bizarre = विचित्र)। Example: He wore an outlandish costume to the party.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as PRAGMATIC.
explanation: Pragmatic = Pragmatic = व्यावहारिक (Practical = Practical = व्यावहारिक, काम का)। Example: She took a pragmatic approach to the problem.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as QUAINT.
explanation: Quaint = Quaint = पुराने ढंग का पर आकर्षक (Old-fashioned = Old-fashioned = पुराने चलन का)। Example: We stayed in a quaint village inn.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as RAVENOUS.
explanation: Ravenous = Ravenous = बहुत भूखा (Hungry = Hungry = भूखा)। Example: After the long trek we were ravenous.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as SEGREGATION.
explanation: Segregation = Segregation = अलगाव (विशेषकर नस्ल के आधार पर) (Separation = Separation = विभाजन)। Example: Segregation in schools was banned by law.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as REMONSTRATE.
explanation: Remonstrate = Remonstrate = ज़ोरदार आपत्ति जताना (Protest = Protest = विरोध करना)। Example: Parents remonstrated with the school over the fee hike.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as VENERATE.
explanation: Venerate = Venerate = पूजनीय मानना (Revere = Revere = श्रद्धा करना)। Example: Indians venerate the river Ganga.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as WAN.
explanation: Wan = Wan = पीला, कमज़ोर-सा (Pallid = Pallid = पीला पड़ा हुआ)। Example: The patient looked wan after the long illness.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as WITHSTOOD.
explanation: Withstood = Withstood = सहन किया, टिके रहे (Endured = Endured = झेला)। Example: The old bridge withstood the floods.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as APATHY.
explanation: Apathy = Apathy = उदासीनता (Indifference = Indifference = बेपरवाही)। Example: Voter apathy lowered the turnout.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as INDISTINCT.
explanation: Indistinct = Indistinct = अस्पष्ट (Blurry = Blurry = धुंधला)। Example: The photo was indistinct in the dim light.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as SHELTERED.
explanation: Sheltered = Sheltered = सुरक्षित, आश्रय पाया हुआ (Protected = Protected = सुरक्षित किया हुआ)। Example: The sheltered valley escaped the storm.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as WEEPY.
explanation: Weepy = Weepy = आँसू भरा, रोने को तैयार (Tearful = Tearful = अश्रुपूर्ण)। Example: She felt weepy at the farewell.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as PASSIVE.
explanation: Passive = Passive = निष्क्रिय (Inactive = Inactive = अक्रिय)। Example: He remained a passive spectator.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as REPRODUCE.
explanation: Reproduce = Reproduce = प्रजनन करना, नकल बनाना (Proliferate = Proliferate = तेज़ी से बढ़ना)। Example: Rabbits reproduce very quickly.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as CASUAL.
explanation: Casual = Casual = अनौपचारिक, सहज (Informal = Informal = बेतकल्लुफ़)। Example: He wore casual clothes to the office party.

question: Choose the word most nearly the same in meaning as ANALYSIS.
explanation: Analysis = Analysis = विश्लेषण (Examination = Examination = जाँच, परीक्षण)। Example: Careful analysis revealed the error in the account.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to LASSITUDE.
explanation: Lassitude ↔ Enthusiasm = Lassitude = सुस्ती, थकावट ↔ Enthusiasm = उत्साह। Example: Lassitude set in after the trek, but her enthusiasm soon returned.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to MISHMASH.
explanation: Mishmash ↔ Organized = Mishmash = घालमेल, बेतरतीब मिश्रण ↔ Organized = व्यवस्थित। Example: His notes were a mishmash, but hers were organized.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to OBEDIENCE.
explanation: Obedience ↔ Rebellion = Obedience = आज्ञाकारिता ↔ Rebellion = विद्रोह। Example: Obedience keeps order, while rebellion breaks it.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to OPPROBRIUM.
explanation: Opprobrium ↔ Honor = Opprobrium = घोर निंदा, बदनामी ↔ Honor = सम्मान। Example: He faced public opprobrium instead of honor.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to SESQUIPEDALIAN.
explanation: Sesquipedalian ↔ Succinct = Sesquipedalian = लंबे-लंबे शब्दों वाला ↔ Succinct = संक्षिप्त। Example: A sesquipedalian speech bored all, but a succinct one pleased them.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to SYBARITIC.
explanation: Sybaritic ↔ Spartan = Sybaritic = विलासी ↔ Spartan = सादगीपूर्ण, कठोर जीवन वाला। Example: A sybaritic life is the opposite of a Spartan one.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to TUMESCENT.
explanation: Tumescent ↔ Atrophied = Tumescent = सूजा हुआ ↔ Atrophied = सिकुड़ा, क्षीण। Example: A tumescent ankle contrasts with an atrophied muscle.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to EQUITABLE.
explanation: Equitable ↔ Unjust = Equitable = न्यायसंगत ↔ Unjust = अन्यायपूर्ण। Example: An equitable law treats all alike, but an unjust law does not.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to CONTUMACIOUS.
explanation: Contumacious ↔ Tractable = Contumacious = हठी, अवज्ञाकारी ↔ Tractable = आज्ञाकारी, सहज वश में आने वाला। Example: Contumacious pupils trouble teachers, but tractable pupils learn easily.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to DAUNTLESS.
explanation: Dauntless ↔ Pusillanimous = Dauntless = निडर ↔ Pusillanimous = कायर, डरपोक। Example: The dauntless knight scorned the pusillanimous squire.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to DILATORY.
explanation: Dilatory ↔ Expeditious = Dilatory = टालमटोल करने वाला ↔ Expeditious = शीघ्र, फुर्तीला। Example: His dilatory habits annoyed the boss, but her expeditious work pleased him.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to ENLIGHTENED.
explanation: Enlightened ↔ Benighted = Enlightened = प्रबुद्ध ↔ Benighted = अज्ञान के अंधकार में। Example: An enlightened ruler shuns a benighted outlook.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to EXTOL.
explanation: Extol ↔ Denounce = Extol = गुणगान करना ↔ Denounce = खुलकर निंदा करना। Example: Critics extol the film, but its rivals denounce it.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to FEARLESS.
explanation: Fearless ↔ Apprehensive = Fearless = निडर ↔ Apprehensive = आशंकित, भयभीत। Example: A fearless pilot calmed the apprehensive passengers.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to KINETIC.
explanation: Kinetic ↔ Stationary = Kinetic = गतिज, गति से संबंधित ↔ Stationary = स्थिर। Example: A moving car has kinetic energy, but a parked car is stationary.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to CONTEMPORARY.
explanation: Contemporary ↔ Antiquated = Contemporary = समकालीन ↔ Antiquated = पुराना, अप्रचलित। Example: Contemporary art differs from antiquated methods.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to EBULLIENT.
explanation: Ebullient ↔ Despondent = Ebullient = उत्साह से भरपूर ↔ Despondent = निराश, हताश। Example: The ebullient crowd faced the despondent players.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to ENERVATE.
explanation: Enervate ↔ Energize = Enervate = शक्तिहीन करना ↔ Energize = ऊर्जा देना। Example: Heat can enervate you, but a cold drink will energize you.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to ERADICATE.
explanation: Eradicate ↔ Foster = Eradicate = जड़ से मिटाना ↔ Foster = पोषण करना, बढ़ावा देना। Example: Let us eradicate hatred and foster friendship.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to PERNICIOUS.
explanation: Pernicious ↔ Salutary = Pernicious = घातक, हानिकारक ↔ Salutary = हितकारी। Example: Pernicious habits harm us, but salutary advice helps.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to VACILLATE.
explanation: Vacillate ↔ Determine = Vacillate = दुविधा में डोलना ↔ Determine = दृढ़ता से तय करना। Example: Don't vacillate; determine your goal and work for it.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to EGREGIOUS.
explanation: Egregious ↔ Commendable = Egregious = घोर (बुरा) ↔ Commendable = सराहनीय। Example: An egregious error spoiled an otherwise commendable effort.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to FEISTY.
explanation: Feisty ↔ Spiritless = Feisty = जोशीला, साहसी ↔ Spiritless = निर्जीव, ढीला-ढाला। Example: The feisty girl faced a spiritless crowd.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to PULCHRITUDINOUS.
explanation: Pulchritudinous ↔ Hideous = Pulchritudinous = अत्यंत सुंदर ↔ Hideous = भयानक रूप से कुरूप। Example: A pulchritudinous bride wore a hideous mask for the prank.

question: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to UXORIOUS.
explanation: Uxorious ↔ Aloof = Uxorious = पत्नी पर अत्यधिक आसक्त ↔ Aloof = उदासीन, दूर-दूर रहने वाला। Example: An uxorious husband is quite unlike an aloof one.
